findings.text: non-blocking: the sweep removes any landing-base- tree with no live holder, with no creation-time gate, so a concurrent measure killed by the scheduler is reclaimed as intended but a tree created during the current pass before its .measurement-owner descriptor is opened (the mkdtemp-to-open window in base_checkout) can be removed by another process's sweep and the landing refused.
